# APE Synthetic Employee Expense Policy 2025

> Synthetic test document for RAG Builder regression testing only.
> This is NOT a real corporate policy and must not be used for payroll or reimbursement advice.

## Part 1 — Commencement

### Section 1 — Effective Date

This synthetic expense policy takes effect on **1 January 2025**.

Unless a later amendment states otherwise, the 2025 meal and travel rules apply from that date.

---

## Part 2 — Meal reimbursement

### Section 10 — Meal reimbursement share

The 2025 meal reimbursement share is **50% of the submitted receipt**.

The unique regression marker is: **APE-EXPENSE-MEAL-SHARE-2025 is 50 percent**.

### Section 11 — Daily meal cap

The 2025 daily meal cap is **BDT 2,000 per day**.

The unique regression marker is: **APE-EXPENSE-MEAL-CAP-2025 is BDT 2,000 per day**.

Reimbursement cannot exceed that daily cap even when 50% of the receipt is larger.

### Section 12 — Worked meal example

If the submitted meal receipt is **BDT 3,000**:

- Receipt amount: BDT 3,000
- Applicable share: 50%
- Meal reimbursement: **BDT 1,500**

The unique regression marker is: **APE-EXPENSE-MEAL-EXAMPLE-2025 reimbursement is BDT 1,500**.

The employee-provided receipt amount must be used directly.

---

## Part 3 — Travel class

### Section 20 — Allowed travel class

Approved business travel uses **economy class**.

The unique regression marker is: **APE-EXPENSE-TRAVEL-CLASS-2025 is economy class**.

This travel-class rule is independent of the meal reimbursement calculation.
